costNote: What policyholders claimed — the insurer's core cost. It was flat at $1,439M (+0.2%) even though reserve remeasurement gains of $453M (from updated actuarial assumptions) reduced it.

opex.name: Acquisition & operating expenses
opex.note: Commissions to Aflac's sales associates plus the cost of running the US and Japan operations. Up just 1.7%.

footerNote: Insurer layout based on Aflac's condensed GAAP statement: GAAP revenue of $3,271M is stated AFTER $1,072M of net investment losses (itemized in the release: $842M losses on sales/redemptions, $146M derivatives/FX, $102M credit-loss provisions, $1M impairments, less a $19M equity gain), so revenue fell 31% while premiums were roughly flat. The tax line includes a $51M valuation allowance on deferred tax assets.

oneTimers.label: Portfolio repositioning — $842M of realized losses
oneTimers.text: Aflac deliberately sold low-yielding bonds during the quarter to reinvest at better rates, crystallizing $842M of losses on sales and redemptions. GAAP punishes the sale now; the benefit arrives as higher investment income later.

oneTimers.label: Tax valuation allowance — $51M
oneTimers.text: A $51M ($0.10/share) valuation allowance against deferred tax assets tied to capital-loss carryforwards — a direct knock-on from realizing those capital losses.

segments.name: Premiums & investment results, net
segments.note: Aflac reports one net revenue line. Inside it: Japan premiums $1,508M and US premiums about $1.5B (both roughly flat in local terms), adjusted net investment income of $639M (Japan) and $212M (US), MINUS $1,072M of net investment losses from repositioning the bond portfolio. Japan's adjusted revenues were $2,156M, the US segment's $1,781M and Corporate & Other's $360M.

sources.label: Aflac Q3 2026 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Nov 4, 2026)

takeaways.text: GAAP EPS collapsed from $3.08 to $0.61 — almost entirely the $1.07B of net investment losses, most of them deliberate sales in a portfolio repositioning. Adjusted EPS, which excludes them, was $2.43.
takeaways.title: A self-inflicted GAAP wound

takeaways.text: Reserve remeasurement gains of $453M (unlocking actuarial assumptions, helped by new reinsurance deals) flattered adjusted earnings — US pretax adjusted earnings rose 31.5% to $493M partly on this.
takeaways.title: Reserve releases did quiet work

takeaways.text: Even in a messy quarter Aflac returned $1.1B ($804M buybacks + $305M dividends) and declared its 44th consecutive annual dividend increase — $0.61 for Q4.
takeaways.title: Dividend streak intact

verdict: A deliberate bond-portfolio overhaul torched GAAP profit ($0.61 vs $3.08); the underlying insurance business was steady, with adjusted EPS of $2.43.
